text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap garners attention as the Hero from the Countryside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek, who will be going up against Oguri Cap in the autumn Tenno Sho, has become a villain in the eyes of the public.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Embracing the role, she decides to run the race as the villain, declaring her intention to defeat Oguri Cap.
